title: use brew's lookup can still reach the link it is about to remove, and the shadow check misreads the link's directory named in another case
body:
`devbin use brew` asks `brew_answer_state` what would answer `devbin` on PATH once the link `~/.local/bin/devbin` is gone, while the link is still there. It leaves out the PATH entries it reads as the link's own directory, and it reads a directory in the case it was typed in, so the lookup still reaches the link through a PATH entry naming `~/.local/bin` in another case on a disk that folds case (APFS's default), and through another `devbin` on PATH that is a link through the link (eg a hand-made `~/bin/devbin -> ../.local/bin/devbin`), which a shell passes over once the link is gone. With the link into a dev or opt tree, as `devbin use` makes it, the answer is `other`, naming the link itself, or a link that will dangle, as the copy to move aside, so `use brew` refuses where Homebrew's devbin would answer. With a link made by hand into Homebrew's keg and Homebrew's bin off PATH, the hit resolves to the keg, the answer is `brew`, and `use brew` removes the link and leaves no devbin on PATH, the outcome T5's amendment A4 exists to prevent; nothing devbin makes gets there, since it takes a hand-made link into the keg and another route to it. `devbin_link_shadow`, which doctor's switch check and a bare `devbin use` ask, reads directories the same way, so a PATH entry naming `~/.local/bin` in another case reads as a devbin shadowing the link, and doctor fails on it. Raised by cc's critic-shell review of 0235.

## Cause

Measured on main at 15f2a973 under bash 5.3.20. The answers quoted come from `~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/174/probe-0235-followups.sh`, which builds a fixture in a new directory, sources main's `lib/helpers` and calls these functions; it runs no bats and no `bin/devbin`.

- `lib/helpers:3849-3866`: `brew_answer_state` reads the link's directory (:3851) and each absolute PATH entry (:3859) in `physical_dir`'s default mode, leaves an entry out only when its spelling equals the link directory's, and hands the rest to bash's own search (:3866), which returns the first `devbin` it finds, a link through the link included.
- `lib/helpers:3868-3871`: the hit is resolved through every link in its chain (`real_path`) and compared with the keg's `bin/devbin`.
- `lib/helpers:614-618`: `physical_dir`'s default mode reads bash's `pwd -P`, which keeps the case a directory was typed in; its `getcwd` mode reads `env pwd -P`, the kernel's spelling (issue 0185). `git_repo_absent` asks for that mode (:2617); `brew_answer_state` and `devbin_link_shadow` do not. On this Mac, with `~/.local/bin` typed in lower case, `pwd -P` prints the lower-case spelling and `env pwd -P` the stored one.
- `lib/helpers:3812-3814`: `devbin_link_shadow` reads the link's directory and the first hit's directory each in the default mode and compares the strings. `lib/cmd/doctor:938-942` fails the switch check on any answer it gives.
- `lib/cmd/use:185-199`: `use brew` accepts a link that `machine_link_state` reads as `at <root>`, and removes it when `brew_answer_state` answers `brew`.
- The probe, with a linked keg and the link into an opt tree: with `~/bin/devbin -> ../.local/bin/devbin` on PATH ahead of Homebrew's bin, `brew_answer_state` answers `other <home>/bin/devbin`, and a shell passes over a dangling `devbin` and finds Homebrew's; with `~/.local/bin` named again in lower case ahead of Homebrew's bin, it answers `other <home in lower case>/.local/bin/devbin`, the link itself; and with that lower-case entry alone on PATH, `devbin_link_shadow` answers "the link <home>/.local/bin/devbin is shadowed: the first devbin on PATH is <home in lower case>/.local/bin/devbin".
- The probe, with a link made by hand into the keg: `machine_link_state` answers `at <prefix>/Cellar/devbin/<version>/libexec`. With Homebrew's bin off PATH, `brew_answer_state` answers `brew <prefix>/opt/devbin/libexec` whether the link is reached again through `~/bin/devbin` or through its directory named in lower case.

## Fix

`brew_answer_state` and `devbin_link_shadow` read every directory they compare in `physical_dir`'s `getcwd` mode, the link's and each PATH entry's alike, so an entry naming the link's directory in any case is the link's directory. `brew_answer_state` then makes the lookup a shell makes once the link is gone: it walks the remaining entries in order and passes over a hit whose chain of links passes through the link, as a shell passes over a link that dangles.

## Done when

1. With `~/bin/devbin` a link to `~/.local/bin/devbin` on PATH ahead of Homebrew's bin and a linked keg, `use brew` removes the link and reports brew. An arm, red on main, where `use brew` refuses naming `~/bin/devbin`, and green at the fix.
2. On a disk that folds case, with a PATH entry naming `~/.local/bin` in another case, `use brew` with a linked keg removes the link and reports brew, and a bare `devbin use` and doctor's switch check say nothing of a shadow. Arms, red on main and green at the fix, each saying it skips where the disk does not fold case.
3. With a link made by hand into Homebrew's keg and Homebrew's bin off PATH, `use brew` refuses, removing nothing, and leaves the link exactly as it was, whether the link is reached again through `~/bin/devbin` or through its directory named in another case. An arm for each route, red on main where the link is removed, and green at the fix.
4. use.bats and doctor.bats pass at the fix under BSD and GNU, beside the tree scans and help.
5. CI's run on the pushed head is green on Test on Ubuntu.

## Deferred to 0.1.17

hv deferred this to devbin 0.1.17 on 2026-10-28 ("defer E to 0.1.17, close 0274 and 0278", relayed verbatim by molt-vc at 18:11Z by date -u). It was built in cc's stage 8 bank for 0.1.16 (s8-rebuild adc44833 in ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/s8/s8a/build, on dc's e3c9c8bb), which had not finished its checks or run. It is not started for 0.1.17: the bank is kept as a starting point and is rebuilt on 0.1.17's base, then checked, run and reviewed as new.

## Resolution

- use brew's lookup (path_hit) is the one a shell makes once the link is gone: it passes over a devbin whose chain of links reaches the link (link_chain_reaches) and reads every directory in physical_dir's getcwd mode, so an entry naming ~/.local/bin in another case is the link's own directory. The shadow check reads directories the same way.
- keg_linked_by_hand in use.bats makes its link through switch_to, test_helper's one writer of the switch's link, so no use.bats line builds into the keg outside brew_keg (0270).
- Landed on main: `1baa3faa`, `8b263335` (the second is the fix for hv's run 20261029-1304).
- Arms: use.bats, use brew passing over a devbin linked through the link; ~/.local/bin in another case; the two refusals with a link made by hand into the keg; a bare use silent of a shadow past ~/.LOCAL/bin; doctor.bats, the switch check past ~/.LOCAL/bin. harness.bats's 0270 keg guard holds use.bats.
- Desk evidence: hv's full run 20261029-1314, 2826 counted, ran every arm above ok, after run 20261029-1313 ran harness.bats's keg guard ok at the fix.
- Run 20261029-1336 (`--failed`) ran that run's two reds, neither in this issue's arms, ok at their fixes, 2 of 2, so main at 5085ae24 is green.
